evaluate.expression: (() => { const link = document.querySelector('a[href$="preview-fixture.md"]'); if (!(link instanceof HTMLElement)) throw new Error('FILEPREVIEW_SEED markdown link not found'); link.click(); })()

metadata.label: Find the FILEPREVIEW_SEED session and open the markdown fixture link

assert.failure_message: Expected the markdown file link to open the file-preview viewer with the markdown renderer (seed.sh hook seeding may be unavailable)

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape' })); await sleep(400); const link = document.querySelector('a[href$="preview-fixture.svg"]'); let opened = false; if (link instanceof HTMLElement) { link.click(); await sleep(900); if (document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-file-viewer-panel"]') && document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-image"]')) { opened = true; } } document.body.setAttribute('data-filepreview-svg-opened', opened ? 'true' : 'false'); })()
